item.text:
Refactored the code for maintainability by tightening the contracts and protecting internal state rather than changing the overall design again.

The key changes are in [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/Graph.java), [DepthFirstGraphAnalysis.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/DepthFirstGraphAnalysis.java), [ArticulationPointAnalysis.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/ArticulationPointAnalysis.java), and [articulation_points.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/articulation_points.java). Public-facing methods now return `List<Integer>` instead of concrete `ArrayList` types, graph construction validates malformed inputs up front, adjacency data is frozen after creation so callers cannot mutate internal state accidentally, and the DFS base class now exposes clearer helper methods like `vertexCount()` and `isRoot()` while enforcing null checks.

Verification passed with `javac *.java && java ArticulationPoints`, and the output remains `1 4`.
